contracts.cognitive_target: Explain how oxygen accepting electrons and protons to form water permits electron flow through the aerobic electron transport chain to continue.
contracts.qualification_focus: Ask which bounded causal statement correctly explains what oxygen does at the end of the aerobic electron transport chain and why electron flow depends on that role.
contracts.correct_option_contract: Oxygen accepts electrons and protons to form water, providing the final acceptor that allows electron flow through the chain to continue.
distractor_contracts: identity-only terminal-acceptor recall without causal effect

contracts.cognitive_target: Contrast fermentation and aerobic respiration using NAD+ regeneration, oxygen as terminal electron acceptor, and relative ATP yield.
contracts.qualification_focus: Ask which bounded statement correctly contrasts fermentation and aerobic respiration across NAD+ regeneration, oxygen use, and ATP yield.
contracts.correct_option_contract: Fermentation regenerates NAD+ so glycolysis can continue without oxygen as terminal electron acceptor and yields much less ATP per glucose than aerobic respiration.
distractor_contracts: fermentation uses oxygen but yields more ATP
aerobic respiration regenerates NAD+ only through fermentation
